coverage_scope: 32 separately discernible package bodies are annotated in this one ESP32 frame. A targeted original-resolution audit found reflective features below U2 that may include additional small SMD packages; their body boundaries cannot be separated reliably from solder/pad reflections in this frame, so complete coverage is not established.
review_method: Manual full-resolution inspection and mask overlay. U2-adjacent package candidates and the RF module substrate perimeter were checked against the original. The three newly added bodies left of U1 were tightened to avoid crossing into U1.
explicit_exclusions: Board outline, mounting holes, silkscreen, and copper pads are not component bodies.
Thirty through-hole header contacts are separately represented as printed-alias point metadata; they are not package-body instances in this component segmentation set.
This frame contains one physical specimen and one capture session; it is not an independent evaluation set.
identity_limits: The exact board variant remains unverified.
Four added package bodies have unreadable or absent markings; their types and designators are intentionally unresolved.
Existing labels remain observational family labels, not installed order-code claims.
Frame-level component coverage remains incomplete because small SMD candidates below U2 are unresolved.

audit_findings: Three new polygons adjacent to U1 were narrowed; their right edges now remain at x<=1426 while the U1 body starts at x>=1429, preventing overlap.
The vertical unknown package to the right of U1 does not intersect the U1 polygon.
The RF module mask follows the visible module substrate and its antenna tail. It excludes the host PCB; castellated module terminals are within the module outline.

Two reflective feature clusters in the area below U2 are visible but their separate package bodies are not reliably distinguishable at this image focus. They remain unannotated; the frame must stay partial and ineligible for standard YOLO export.
